title: Nonempty free support of a compatible term
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ sign-valued Boolean variables, and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction for which the restricted function is nonconstant. The support of the first term compatible with $\rho$ has a nonempty intersection with the coordinates left free by $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on $n$ variables
The function restricted by $\rho$ is nonconstant
